name: LLaVA-Instruct-150K
description: An instruction-following dataset of approximately 150,000 multimodal conversations generated from image-text data and used to train LLaVA. This record does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Liu, H., Li, C., Wu, Q., & Lee, Y. J. (2023). Visual Instruction Tuning. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems, 36. https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.08485
